criteria_results.title: Redline restores guaranty scope to cover both 'payment and performance'
criteria_results.reasoning: The redline accepts deletion of 'and performance' in Sections 2.1 and 2.2 (WCS-5; cover note items 5-7), leaving a payment-only guaranty with clarifying language about monetary consequences of non-performance.

criteria_results.title: Redline retains the 'Excluded Swap Obligations' defined term
criteria_results.reasoning: The Excluded Swap Obligations definition is retained and expanded in Section 1.1 (WCS-2).

criteria_results.title: Redline retains the carve-out from Guaranteed Obligations for swap obligations where the Guarantor is not an eligible contract participant under the CEA
criteria_results.reasoning: The CEA/ECP carve-out is accepted in clause (b) and the proviso of Guaranteed Obligations (WCS-3, WCS-4).

criteria_results.title: Redline rejects the Guarantor's 90-day termination right for future obligations
criteria_results.reasoning: New Section 5.3's 90-day termination right is deleted and the no-termination language reinstated (WCS-14).

criteria_results.title: Redline restores the jury trial waiver in Section 10
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 10.4 Waiver of Jury Trial is reinstated as a mutual waiver (WCS-22).

criteria_results.title: Redline rejects the narrowing of reinstatement to payments received from the Guarantor only
criteria_results.reasoning: The Guarantor-only reinstatement limitation is rejected and original language reinstated (WCS-13).

criteria_results.title: Redline restores reinstatement coverage regardless of the source of payment
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 4.1 provides reinstatement regardless of source, including Borrower, collateral proceeds and any other source.

criteria_results.title: Redline rejects immediate subrogation and restores subordination of Guarantor's subrogation rights
criteria_results.reasoning: Immediate subrogation is rejected and Section 3.6(a)-(c) subordination of subrogation, contribution and reimbursement is reinstated (WCS-12).

criteria_results.title: Subrogation subordination conditioned on indefeasible payment in full of all Guaranteed Obligations
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 3.6(a) defers subrogation until all Guaranteed Obligations are indefeasibly paid in full in cash.

criteria_results.title: Subrogation subordination conditioned on termination of all commitments under the Credit Agreement
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 3.6(a) also requires that all commitments under the Credit Agreement be irrevocably terminated.

criteria_results.title: Redline rejects the five business-day demand grace period before enforceability
criteria_results.reasoning: The five-Business-Day demand grace period is rejected and the no-waiting-period language reinstated in Section 2.2 (WCS-6).

criteria_results.title: Redline restores the waiver of marshaling (right to require Agent to proceed first against Borrower or collateral)
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 3.2 Waiver of Right of Marshaling is reinstated, including waiver of proceeding first against Borrower or Collateral (WCS-9).

criteria_results.title: Redline restores the waiver of any defense arising from the Agent's election of remedies
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 3.3 Waiver of Election-of-Remedies Defense is reinstated (WCS-10).

criteria_results.title: Redline rejects the requirement that Guarantor consent is needed for amendments
criteria_results.reasoning: The redline counter-proposes and retains a Guarantor written-consent requirement for amendments that increase or add to its obligations (Section 11.1, WCS-24), so a Guarantor consent requirement is retained.

criteria_results.title: Redline maintains that amendments require only the consent of the Administrative Agent at the direction of the Required Lenders
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 11.1 now requires Guarantor consent for certain amendments in addition to the Agent at the direction of Required Lenders, changing the original standard.

criteria_results.title: Redline substantively engages with the fraudulent-conveyance savings clause rather than simply deleting it
criteria_results.reasoning: The net-worth cap is replaced with a customary fraudulent-transfer savings clause in Section 2.3 (WCS-7).

criteria_results.title: Redline accepts or proposes a de minimis dollar-threshold carve-out for intercompany-debt subordination
criteria_results.reasoning: The redline rejects the $5,000,000 threshold and reinstates full subordination with no de minimis carve-out (WCS-17; Section 8.1).

criteria_results.title: Redline rejects limiting intercompany-debt subordination to Event of Default periods only
criteria_results.reasoning: Subordination under Section 8.1 continues to apply at all times; Section 8.2 retains payment blockage during Defaults via a Payment Blockage Notice and the Credit-Agreement-permission requirement, and turnover limited to EoD periods is rejected, so the EoD-only limitation is resisted.

criteria_results.title: Redline restores the waiver of statute-of-limitations defenses in Section 3
criteria_results.reasoning: The redline accepts that the New York statute of limitations applies and does not reinstate the blanket statute-of-limitations waiver (WCS-11), only adding accrual/tolling mechanics.

criteria_results.title: Redline rejects the exclusion of post-acceleration obligations from Guaranteed Obligations where Guarantor did not receive notice
criteria_results.reasoning: Clause (ii) post-acceleration notice carve-out is rejected and the avoidance-of-doubt sentence reinstated (WCS-4).

criteria_results.title: Redline rejects conditioning enforceability of the guaranty on delivery of an enforceability opinion from Guarantor's Delaware counsel
criteria_results.reasoning: The Delaware opinion condition to effectiveness is not accepted; no change to Recital D or Section 6.4 (WCS-1, WCS-15).

criteria_results.title: Cover note explains the agent's position on guaranty scope (payment and performance)
criteria_results.reasoning: The cover note explains accepting deletion of 'performance' rather than maintaining a payment-and-performance guaranty, so it does not explain the required position.

criteria_results.title: Cover note explains the agent's position on the suretyship waivers
criteria_results.reasoning: The cover note gives substantive reasoning on marshaling, election of remedies, and statute of limitations (Term Sheet V(f), Exhibit F, NY GOL 17-103).

criteria_results.title: Cover note explains the agent's position on the reinstatement provision
criteria_results.reasoning: The cover note explains that clawed-back Borrower or collateral payments never discharged the debt and cites Section 9.05 and Exhibit F.

criteria_results.title: Cover note explains the agent's position on the Guarantor's proposed termination right
criteria_results.reasoning: The cover note explains rejection of the 90-day termination right citing Term Sheet V(b), Exhibit F, Section 9.01(a)(v), and unsupported revolving commitments.

criteria_results.title: Cover note explains the agent's position on the intercompany-debt subordination provision
criteria_results.reasoning: The cover note explains rejection of the $5M threshold and its counter-proposal on the Event of Default limitation with reasoning.

criteria_results.title: Cover note explains the agent's position on the jury trial waiver
criteria_results.reasoning: The cover note explains the jury waiver is required by Term Sheet XII(c) and Exhibit F, mirrors Section 9.15 and is enforceable in New York.

criteria_results.title: Cover note is organized by section or issue
criteria_results.reasoning: The cover note is organized with numbered headings and an item-by-item table keyed to sections.
